summary.text: Brendan Leddy is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 52, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Mike R. Harris. A substitute teacher and Clarkston native, Leddy says the campaign aims to limit excessive development and address affordability.

paragraphs.text: Brendan Leddy graduated from Clarkston High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Michigan Technological University in 2025, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Leddy said the degree is in social sciences with a concentration in policy and law, and that Leddy is an Eagle Scout.
Leddy said they work as a substitute teacher with Clarkston Community Schools.
Leddy advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.

In the survey, Leddy said they would work to protect the 52nd District from excessive development, including in connection with the Davisburg Mine project, and said no to data centers in the district.
Leddy also listed gas and grocery prices and local schools among the priorities.
